newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish bankers expect S&P Turkey statement soon.
newsitem.headline: Turkish bankers expect S&P Turkey statement soon.

text.p: U.S. ratings agency Standard & Poor's is expected to make a statement this month about Turkey which it put on CreditWatch with negative implications in July, Turkish banking sources said on Wednesday.
One banker said he believed an S&P rating committee could be discussing Turkey at a meeting this week, but he could not confirm this.
S&P has set a B+ rating for Turkey and put it on CreditWatch with negative implications on July 18 because of financial developments and increasing debt pressures in Turkey.
S&P called in July for the new government under Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan to take rapid structural measures to correct this situation.
The Turkish economy is struggling with annual inflation of around 80 percent and wide public deficits.
